content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for ECHS Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.echs.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 12-10-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Ex Servicemen Contributory Health Scheme (ECHS) for various medical and non-medical positions.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under ECHS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 8 vacancies have been announced for different posts including OIC, Medical Officer, Medical Specialist, Gynecologist, Safaiwala, IT Network Tech, and MTS.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date for the receipt of completed offline applications is 12-10-2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for ECHS jobs?
faq.answer: Candidates must submit their applications through offline mode by post, by hand, or via email to the designated ECHS Cell address.

faq.question: Q5. What are the minimum and maximum qualifications required?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification required is 8th pass for posts like MTS, while higher posts require qualifications such as Graduate, MBBS, Diploma, and MD/MS/DNB.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary range for ECHS staff?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 21,800 to Rs. 1,30,000 depending on the specific post.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned in the official notification for applying to these posts.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for ECHS recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a 10-day On Job Training (OJT) followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q9. Where should the application form be sent?
faq.answer: Applications must be sent to OIC, ECHS Cell, Stn HQ Barrackpore, (WB) PIN – 700120, or via email at [email protected].

faq.question: Q10. Where can I download the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: You can download the notification and application form from the official website at www.echs.gov.in.
